title: Agent Org
description: Live organizational state of a self-organizing agent org: the whole node tree with charters inlined. This schema validates STRUCTURE only. Semantic coverage (exactly-one-owner via effective domain, overlap/uncovered, tree back-references and shape) is computed by the owner-oracle (owner_validator.py in the agent-org plugin); see the agent-org-design skill §2.2 and §2.7.

version.description: Org-state version. Bumped by exactly one on every committed split.

root.description: id of the root node. The Host hardcodes the entry point to this node.

id.description: Stable, hierarchy-free identifier. Never renamed across reorgs.

parent.description: id of the parent node, or null for the root.

children.description: ids of direct children. Empty for a Leaf.

mode.description: Parent = scatter-gather over children. Leaf = executes directly.

domain.description: Glob patterns (gitignore semantics) the node owns. For a Parent this is an explicit shared set (root/org/contract files common to its children), never '**'. Effective domain = domain minus excludes.

excludes.description: Globs a node's domain would match but that are owned elsewhere (a cross-cutting sibling). Effective domain = domain minus excludes. A materialized excluded path that no other node covers surfaces as UNOWNED via the owner-oracle; see the agent-org-design skill §2.2, §2.7.
